value.rationale: The smallest classical order17 Paley Ramsey graph has natural 136-element affine symmetry. The integral cyclotomic translation lattice, unimodular cycle orbit, and rational irreducible two-orbit character supply invariants beyond its already-known Betti number, with clear applications to comparing equivariant graph-complex constructions.
